subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should OpenClaw make a single process-wide session-discussion provider plus `session.discussion.*` gateway methods a permanent public plugin SDK contract, or should this remain provider-owned until a broader multi-provider/control-UI design is approved?
rationale: The code is not only a mechanical repair: it adds a new public plugin SDK subpath, gateway protocol methods, and a Control UI product surface whose ownership and future extensibility cannot be safely inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt the generic contract with lifecycle ownership
options.body: Keep the generic seam, but first integrate provider registration with plugin rollback, removal, and reload cleanup so only an active plugin can serve requests.

options.title: Keep the integration provider-owned for now
options.body: Do not add the permanent core SDK/gateway surface until maintainers choose the expected provider multiplicity and Control UI ownership model.

recommendation.title: Adopt the generic contract with lifecycle ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the generic seam, but first integrate provider registration with plugin rollback, removal, and reload cleanup so only an active plugin can serve requests.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit sequence shows steipete designed the proposed contract and is the strongest available routing candidate for the API-direction discussion.
